title: Multipliers for Entire Functions and an Interpolation Problem of Beurling
version: Repository author manuscript dated15August1998; published1999 identity verified against repository and publisher metadata
read_scope: Manuscript introduction and exact definitions/Theorem1,pp1–3. Bernstein interpolation and density/separation/Carleson hypotheses read directly. main_result_inspected: Theorem1,p2 characterizes interpolation in BernsteinB_tau by separation for sigma(z,w)=|z-w|/[1+|z-conjw|], a two-sided Carleson condition, and upper uniform densityD+<tau/pi. For real sets the Carleson sum vanishes and this separation is equivalent to positive Euclidean separation. The source explicitly distinguishes Bernstein from Paley-WienerLp atcriticaldensity.
research_connection: With strict density margin choose tau0<pi; bounded Bernstein Lagrange functions multiplied by a squared-sinc envelope give bounded ell² interpolation inPW_pi². This supplies the exact external Riesz input in the sine-Gram no-zero-atom proof.
